219:t_016:5.en:
$$バサラ$$
「...I can't explain it well...! But something's nagging at me!」

219:t_100:0.en:
$$レド$$
「To think the habitat of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ had spread all the way out here...!」

219:t_100:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Inference: the cause is the expanding battle at the galactic core.」

219:t_100:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Then we hit them before they can breed any more...! This universe belongs to humanity!」

219:t_101:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Damn $$バジュラ$$. They go after the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ and us alike, no distinction.」

219:t_101:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Data of all types on the swarm currently engaged is insufficient.」

219:t_101:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Collect it while we fight. It's what we did on Earth.」

219:t_101:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Carrying out your instructions, officer.」

219:t_102:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I thought we were shut in the $$地球圏$$, and now we're forced into the dead center of the galaxy...!」

219:t_102:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm not dying in a place like this! We've still got unfinished business back on Earth!」

219:t_103:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「The dead center of the galaxy is our stage! This is gonna burn!」

219:t_103:1.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「He has no idea how serious this is!」

219:t_103:2.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「But at a time like this, that unwavering attitude is actually reassuring.」

219:t_103:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Quit your fussing! The live started a long time ago!」

219:t_103:5.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Geez! You're just not thinking about anything!」

219:t_104:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
(The galactic core... It makes me realize how small humans are...)

219:t_104:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I can't die yet, $$ララァ$$...)

219:t_105:0.en:
$$シャア$$
(To think I'd feel the vastness of space again in a way like this...)

219:t_105:1.en:
$$シャア$$
($$ララァ$$... This expanding consciousness... I'd like to convey it to all of humanity...!)

219:t_106:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(This sense of my consciousness spreading... Is my $$ニュータイプ$$ ability expanding?)

219:t_106:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(So this is the real universe... Will the people of Earth someday make this place their home, too...)

219:t_107:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(So this is the galaxy... A universe of infinite expanse...)

219:t_107:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(What is this... It could be a hopeless situation, yet my heart is leaping...)

219:t_107:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$オードリー$$... I want to convey what I'm feeling right now to you, too...!)

219:t_108:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If the $$クォーター$$ gives me energy, I can fire the $$サテライトキャノン$$ once every 2 minutes! I'll make it happen!」

219:t_108:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm going to survive, no matter what! And I'm definitely going back to Earth with $$ティファ$$!」

219:t_109:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Miss $$ソシエ$$, Miss $$キエル$$... and $$ディアナ$$... I've come all the way out here...)

219:t_109:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
($$ディアナ$$ once told me that the $$ムーンレィス$$ were a people who could not give up their longing for Earth.)

219:t_109:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
(It's the same for me. No matter what hardships there are, I'll definitely return to the Earth where everyone is waiting for me...!)

219:t_110:0.en:
$$シン$$
「The sea of stars with the space whales, from a book I read as a kid... I never thought I'd end up coming like this...」

219:t_110:1.en:
$$シン$$
「But I have a wish to stop the war! I'm definitely going back to Earth!」

219:t_111:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「There are battles in the galaxy, too... Battles fought for survival, unlike those on Earth...」

219:t_111:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll live...! Because there's something I have to do on Earth!」

219:t_112:0.en:
$$刹那$$
(That sense of wrongness I felt then... What was that...)

219:t_112:1.en:
$$刹那$$
(What do I... want to do...)

219:t_113:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's huge...! How vast space is!」

219:t_113:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I, I don't know why, but I feel like screaming at the top of my lungs!」

219:t_114:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
(That $$時空震動|lc$$ back then... The $$スフィア$$ reacted to something...)

219:t_114:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I have a bad feeling... Something is about to start moving...)

219:t_115:0.en:
$n
(I'm sorry, $$宗介$$... I couldn't save you and $$千鳥$$...)

219:t_115:1.en:
$n
(But it isn't over yet...! I... we will definitely return to Earth!)

219:t_115:2.en:
$n
(And then I'll do it...! I'll definitely rescue $$千鳥$$!)
